description: This source file contains unit tests for the Warehouse plugin of a device management system. It uses Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to test various methods, including device reset, hardware testing, device info retrieval, and event handling. The tests mock dependencies like IARM bus interactions, RFC API, and system commands to verify the plugin's behavior under different scenarios.

classes.name: WarehouseTest
classes.description: Base test fixture for Warehouse plugin tests, initializing plugin, handler, and connection.

classes.name: WarehouseInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived fixture that sets up mocks and initializes the plugin, including event handler registration.

classes.name: WarehouseEventTest
classes.description: Fixture for testing event handling within the Warehouse plugin, activating a mock service.

classes.name: WarehouseResetDeviceTest
classes.description: Fixture for testing reset device commands, subscribing to reset done events and mocking handler responses.

classes.name: WarehouseResetDeviceFailureTest
classes.description: Variant that simulates failure responses during reset commands.

methods.name: registeredMethods
methods.description: Test verifying the existence of specific methods in the JSON RPC handler.

methods.name: WarehouseResetDeviceTest / ColdFactoryResetDevice
methods.description: Test invoking a cold factory reset, verifying the correct IARM bus call and response.

methods.name: WarehouseResetDeviceTest / FactoryResetDevice
methods.description: Test invoking a factory reset, checking correct system commands and events.

methods.name: WarehouseResetDeviceTest / UserFactoryResetDevice
methods.description: Test invoking a user factory reset with proper command execution.

methods.name: WarehouseResetDeviceTest / GenericResetDevice
methods.description: Test invoking a generic reset with minimal parameters.

methods.name: internalResetFailPassPhrase
methods.description: Test invoking internalReset without passphrase or with incorrect passphrase.

methods.name: internalResetScriptFail
methods.description: Test internalReset when the script execution fails.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Test successful internalReset operation, including script execution.

methods.name: lightResetScriptFail
methods.description: Test lightReset when the script execution fails.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Tests the isClean method, verifying detection of configuration/state files and their contents.

methods.name: executeHardwareTest
methods.description: Test the execution of hardware tests, verifying RFC parameter setting.

methods.name: getHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Test retrieving hardware test results via RFC parameters.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Test fetching device information by executing a shell script and parsing its output.

methods.name: statusChangeEvent
methods.description: Test the handling of warehouse status change events.
